# cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config (Resource)

Manages the AWS Lambda function discovery configuration of a Cofide Connect cloud account, independently of the `cofide_connect_cloud_account` resource. Useful when the cloud account's existence is managed by automatic discovery rather than Terraform: only this specific configuration is managed here, referencing the account by ID. Do not manage this configuration both here and inline on `cofide_connect_cloud_account.aws.lambda_discovery_config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ------ Example: ./examples_tmp/resources/cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config ------
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "cloud_account_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud account this configuration applies to."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-account-id"
}

variable "discovery_role_arn" {
  description = "The ARN of the IAM role to assume for discovery."
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cofide-discovery"
}


# Useful when the cloud account's existence is managed by automatic
# discovery rather than Terraform: only the Lambda discovery config is
# managed here, referencing the account by ID.
resource "cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config" "example" {
  cloud_account_id   = var.cloud_account_id
  audience           = "spiffe://example.org/lambda-discovery"
  regions            = ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
  discovery_enabled  = true
  discovery_interval = "5m"

  role_chain = [
    {
      iam_role_arn = var.discovery_role_arn
    }
  ]
}


output "status" {
  description = "The current status of Lambda discovery."
  value       = cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call. Only used when `assume_through_oidc` is true.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) The ID of the cloud account this configuration applies to. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume when discovering Lambda functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_chain))

### Optional

- `assume_through_oidc` (Boolean) Whether the first role in `role_chain` is assumed via SPIFFE JWT-based AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity (the default) or via ambient credentials such as EKS Pod Identity (`false`).
- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this config.
- `discovery_interval` (String) How frequently discovery runs for this config (a Go duration string, e.g. `1m`, `1h`). Defaults to a server-assigned value when unset.
- `regions` (List of String) AWS regions to discover resources in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. Matches `cloud_account_id`.
- `last_successful_discovery` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery run.
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).
- `status_last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last status update.

<a id="nestedatt--role_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_chain`

Required:

- `iam_role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role to assume.

Optional:

- `external_id` (String) Optional external ID for confused-deputy protection.
